skills.name: Periodic Waveform
skills.description:
Passive: Summons may be deployed on Melee tiles
Active: Raidian and her summons gain DEF <@ba.vup>+{def:0%}</> and gain a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{hp_ratio:0%}</> of Max HP until this skill ends
<@ba.rem>Immediately gain 1 summon when the skill is activated</>
